criteria.title: Predict which declared detector or invariant monitor can observe an extent, initialization, lifetime or resource defect on a selected path.
criteria.task: Build a property-to-observer matrix for physical extent, logical field boundary, initialized value, stale lifetime and retained-resource budget. Give one original negative control each and predict which observer can miss it.

deliverables.D1: Prediction and causal explanation addressing: Addressability implies initialized and semantically valid data.
deliverables.D2: Build a property-to-observer matrix for physical extent, logical field boundary, initialized value, stale lifetime and retained-resource budget. Give one original negative control each and predict which observer can miss it.
